==Education==
Apweiler gained his [[PhD]] in [[biochemistry]] from [[Heidelberg University]].<ref name=phd>{{cite thesis |degree=PhD |first=Rolf|last=Apweiler |title=Charakterisierung der Wirkung von ( - )-2-(4-Methylphenoxy)-7-(4-Chlorophenyl)-Heptansäure auf die Insulinsensitivität und Glucosetoleranz von fa-fa- und FA-?-Ratten |publisher=University of Heidelberg |date=1994 |url=http://d-nb.info/941652920|oclc=75488289}}</ref><ref>http://pir.uniprot.org/help/apweiler Rolf Apweiler page at UniProt.org  {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140222172434/http://pir.uniprot.org/help/apweiler |date=February 22, 2014 }}</ref>

==Research==
Apweiler has been working on the [[Swiss-Prot]]<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Boeckmann | first1 = B. | last2 = Bairoch | first2 = A. | last3 = Apweiler | first3 = R. | last4 = Blatter | first4 = M. C. | last5 = Estreicher | first5 = A. | last6 = Gasteiger | first6 = E. | last7 = Martin | first7 = M. J. | last8 = Michoud | first8 = K. | last9 = O'Donovan | first9 = C. | last10 = Phan | first10 = I. | last11 = Pilbout | first11 = S. | last12 = Schneider | first12 = M. | title = The SWISS-PROT protein knowledgebase and its supplement TrEMBL in 2003 | doi = 10.1093/nar/gkg095 | journal = Nucleic Acids Research | volume = 31 | issue = 1 | pages = 365–370 | year = 2003 | pmid =  12520024| pmc =165542 }}</ref> [[protein sequence]] database since 1987, and in 1994 he became leader of the Swiss-Prot group. He has been joint head of the [[Protein]] and [[Nucleotide]] Data (PANDA) Group since 2007. The PANDA group is involved in several international collaborations like the [[Human Proteome Organization]] (HUPO) [[Proteomics Standards Initiative]]. Apweiler is a member of the Nomenclature Committee of [[IUBMB]], the [[FlyBase]] advisory board, the committee of the [[Helmholtz Association of German Research Centres|Helmholtz Centre for Infection Research]] (HZI) and the advisory board of the [[Human Proteome Resource]] (HPR).

Apweiler is an editor of the ''[[FEBS Journal]]'' and a section editor of ''[[BMC Bioinformatics]]'' and has published more than 200 papers.<ref>https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=rolf+apweiler Rolf Apweiler in [[Google Scholar]]</ref><ref name="DBLP">{{DBLP|name=Rolf Apweiler}}</ref><ref name="scopus">{{Scopus id}}</ref>

===Awards and honours===
Apweiler was elected a member of the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] (EMBO) in 2012,<ref name=embo>{{cite web|url=http://www.embo.org/documents/members/The_EMBO_Pocket_Directory.pd|title=The EMBO Pocket Directory|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150316002020/http://www.embo.org/documents/members/The_EMBO_Pocket_Directory.pdf|archive-date=2015-03-16|publisher=European Molecular Biology Organization}}</ref> elected a [[Fellow]] of the [[International Society for Computational Biology]] in 2015<ref name=iscb-fellow>{{cite web|title=Meet the ISCB Fellows Class of 2015|url=http://www.iscb.org/iscb-news-items/2392-2015feb20-meet-the-iscb-fellows-class-of-2015|access-date=20 February 2015}}</ref> and elected a member of the [[Academia Europaea]] in 2022.<ref>{{cite web|title=Rolf Apweiler|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Apweiler_Rolf|work=Member|publisher=Academia Europaea|access-date=2024-08-25}}</ref>
